correction.supersededAssumption: DOMContentLoaded was incorrectly required to have one stable production-CSS geometry. The immutable runs show two canonical states depending on whether the external host stylesheet had applied at that milestone.

executionProfile.caveat: The 4g runtime ECT stabilizes Chromium native lazy-load distance selection; it is not the transfer profile. Lighthouse computes the published metrics with its separate simulated Slow 4G / CPU x4 model.
executionProfile.lighthouseMetrics: simulated Slow 4G with Lighthouse CPU slowdown x4

priorAttempts.reason: The sandboxed first launch could not fetch the loopback DevTools WebSocket URL. It failed before navigation and produced no Lighthouse LHR or page probe.

The old harness rejected a valid below-fold paint handoff because it required all 18 editor assets whenever the iframe Document loaded. The preserved run had the exact four-response paint-deferred shell and no failed request.

thresholdResult.interpretation: The experiment proves that native lazy loading did not suppress the Document request at any tested position. It does not prove a numerical request cutoff.
thresholdResult.reason: Every tested position requested and loaded the iframe Document; the study contains no not-requested point, so it cannot bound the exact cutoff.

requestTimeGeometry.explanation: The placement sheet was installed before every request, but Resource Timing shows each app request began before the passive first-seen geometry sample. Final and first-seen distances are therefore published separately and are not mislabeled as direct request-time geometry.

validity.reason: This correction validates the requested lazy-iframe position experiment. It does not define or apply the future Criterion 12 acceptance budget.

portablePackage.nestedPathBindingSemantics: Nested <source-attempt-N> paths identify original immutable inputs. Tracked package paths are used only when adjacent bytes/SHA bind the byte-identical portable artifact.

criterion7.reason: Clipboard success with permission and the permission-denied fallback require a manual browser session.

criterion14.reason: Allowed-origin framing and rejection of phe-preview.com require external-origin browser access.
